# nlohmann/json

Pinned version: **3.12.0**. Upstream: <https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0>.

The unmodified modular headers were copied from the installed Homebrew
`nlohmann-json` 3.12.0 package. Their upstream version and copyright notices are
preserved. License: `nlohmann.LICENSE.MIT`.

`nlohmann.SHA256SUMS` records every header. CMake verifies these hashes during
configuration; builds do not download dependencies or select system headers.
When deliberately upgrading, replace the headers and license, regenerate the
manifest, and rerun Debug, Release and integration tests. The manifest detects
accidental local changes; it is not an upstream signature.
